# HelloServer Controller - React Server Components
# This controller demonstrates how to render RSC pages with streaming SSR.
# It's the RSC counterpart to HelloWorldController.
#
# ReactOnRailsPro::Stream provides:
# - stream_view_containing_react_components: Streams the view with RSC support
# - Streaming HTML chunks as components render
# - Automatic hydration on the client
#
# For more information, see:
# https://reactonrails.com/docs/pro/react-server-components/

class HelloServerController < ApplicationController
  layout "react_on_rails_default"

  include ReactOnRailsPro::Stream

  def index
    @hello_server_props = {
      name: "React on Rails Pro"
    }

    stream_view_containing_react_components(template: "hello_server/index")
  end
end

class SubscribersController < ApplicationController
  def new
    @subscriber = Subscriber.new
  end

  def create
    @subscriber = Subscriber.new(subscriber_params)

    if @subscriber.save
      redirect_to subscriber_path(@subscriber), notice: "You're subscribed!"
    else
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def show
    @subscriber = Subscriber.find(params[:id])
  end

  private

  def subscriber_params
    params.require(:subscriber).permit(:email)
  end
end

class Subscriber < ApplicationRecord
  EMAIL_FORMAT = /\A[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\z/

  before_validation { email&.strip! }

  validates :email,
            presence: true,
            format: { with: EMAIL_FORMAT, message: "must be a valid email address" },
            uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false }
end

require "test_helper"

class SubscribersControllerTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  test "gets the new subscriber form" do
    get new_subscriber_path

    assert_response :success
    assert_select "form"
  end

  test "renders validation errors and does not create a record on invalid submission" do
    assert_no_difference("Subscriber.count") do
      post subscribers_path, params: { subscriber: { email: "not-an-email" } }
    end

    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert_select "#subscriber-errors"
    assert_select "#subscriber-errors li", text: /must be a valid email address/
  end

  test "creates a subscriber and redirects on successful submission" do
    assert_difference("Subscriber.count", 1) do
      post subscribers_path, params: { subscriber: { email: "fresh-person@example.com" } }
    end

    subscriber = Subscriber.order(:created_at).last
    assert_redirected_to subscriber_path(subscriber)

    follow_redirect!
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "#subscriber-email", text: /fresh-person@example.com/
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class SubscriberTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "invalid without an email" do
    subscriber = Subscriber.new(email: "")

    assert_not subscriber.valid?
    assert_includes subscriber.errors[:email], "can't be blank"
  end

  test "invalid with a malformed email" do
    subscriber = Subscriber.new(email: "not-an-email")

    assert_not subscriber.valid?
    assert_includes subscriber.errors[:email], "must be a valid email address"
  end

  test "invalid with a duplicate email" do
    Subscriber.create!(email: "person@example.com")
    duplicate = Subscriber.new(email: "PERSON@example.com")

    assert_not duplicate.valid?
    assert_includes duplicate.errors[:email], "has already been taken"
  end

  test "valid with a proper, unique email" do
    subscriber = Subscriber.new(email: "new-person@example.com")

    assert subscriber.valid?
  end
end
